the rheology of the synthesized polypropylene reactor blend is highly dependent on the molar ratios used to synthesize the blend.
the morphology and rheological properties of the bimodal polyolefins are highly dependent on the molar ratio between the two catalysts.
the rheological and morphological characteristics of biaxial reactor polypropylene blends synthesized with binary catalysts are governed by the molar ratio between two catalysts.

by changing the molar ratio in the binary system of metallocene catalysts, the molecular weight and molecular-weight distribution of bimodal reactor blends can be controlled.

the rheological properties and morphology of the bimodal polyolefins can be tuned by changing the molar ratio and type of the catalysts.
